boundary: The lower odd syndrome orbit atlas is complete. The minimum-weight-five multiplicity atlas is exact in one coordinate chart and global counts are exact by edge transitivity, but the full PSp orbit decomposition of all minimum-weight-five syndromes remains open.
theorem: Every syndrome reachable at odd weight below five lies in one of exactly 110 PSp(4,3)-orbits. One orbit has minimum weight one and 109 have minimum weight three. Coupled with the exact fixed-coordinate weight-five multiplicity sort, this is a symmetry-compressed fail-closed decoder atlas for all lower shadows and all local minimum multiplicities.
